enumeration.method: Parsed configure.py and its pre-promotion parent revision with Python's AST, selecting Object calls whose first positional argument is the NonMatching name. This handles both single-line and multiline formatting. Mapped each source argument to main/<source path without extension> in the freshly rebuilt canonical objdiff report and selected fuzzy_match_percent == 100.0.
enumeration.audit_command:
python3 - <<'PY'
import ast,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path('.')
report=json.loads((root/'build/GEDE01/report.json').read_text())
units={u['name']:u for u in report['units']}
for label,text in [('baseline',subprocess.check_output(['git','show','131d92f72^:eternal-darkness-decomp/configure.py'],text=True)),('remaining',(root/'configure.py').read_text())]:
    sources=[ast.literal_eval(n.args[1]) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(text)) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Name) and n.func.id=='Object' and len(n.args)>=2 and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Name) and n.args[0].id=='NonMatching']
    mapped=[]; missing=[]
    for s in sources:
        name='main/'+s.removeprefix('src/').removesuffix('.c')
        (mapped if name in units else missing).append(units[name] if name in units else name)
    total=lambda key:sum(int(u.get('measures',{}).get(key,0)) for u in mapped)
    candidates=[u for u in mapped if float(u.get('measures',{}).get('fuzzy_match_percent',0))==100.0]
    print(f'{label}: registrations={len(sources)} mapped={len(mapped)} unmapped={len(missing)} code_bytes={total("total_code")} data_bytes={total("total_data")} functions={total("total_functions")} candidates={len(candidates)}')
    print(f'{label}_candidate_units: '+(','.join(u['name'] for u in candidates) if candidates else '(none)'))
    print(f'{label}_unmapped_units: '+(','.join(missing) if missing else '(none)'))
PY
